_comment: Every engine class is exposed except what the groups deny. Each group is a named class set with ONE policy: "deny" blocks reads and writes (never unlockable), "write" allows reads only, "ask" prompts via godot.requestTier(name) + confirmation dialog, "allow" grants silently, "off" is dormant (classes fully permitted, kept for re-enablement). "protected" groups are sandbox escapes: the dock will only ever offer deny/write/off for them. deny_classes/deny_members/restrict stay as flat escape hatches. Legacy tiers/tier_policy/unlocked_tiers/auto_grant_tiers still load and migrate into groups. Meta-methods (call/set/emit_signal/free/...) are always blocked in code.

execution._why: Arbitrary code execution and reflection escape the sandbox entirely. Script files go through the trusted godot.createScript / godot.attachScript ops instead.

process._why: Process, windowing and threading control: OS.execute, engine quit, scene-tree hijack and threads would let agent code escape the worker sandbox.

interop._why: Bridges to other runtimes (JS, JVM) execute outside the sandbox model.

config._why: Settings reads are agent-useful metadata (project layout, editor prefs); writes mutate project/editor state, so they stay denied.

text._why: Text shaping/font queries are harmless reads; the denied surface is mutating the TextServerManager singletons.

capture._why: Camera/microphone access is a privacy gate: promptable rather than impossible.

crypto._why: Key generation, signing and cert handling could touch user identity material; prompt-gated.

network._why: Sockets, HTTP, multiplayer peers. Low risk on its own — cannot reach files without filesystem.

filesystem._why: Reading/writing arbitrary files on disk. The sensitive one: it can read .env files, SSH keys, project secrets.

untracked._why: Generic native and project-script execution without undo or rollback; called code may touch scene, files or network. Not a class gate — a mode gate.

_audit_note: Dropped vs 0.3.3 deny list: Mutex and Semaphore (inert without Thread, which stays denied). Moved to write-only: ProjectSettings, EditorSettings, EditorCommandPalette, EditorVCSInterface, TextServer* (reads are harmless lookups). Moved to ask groups: capture and crypto classes (unlockable with a prompt instead of impossible).
